LESSON: CONTEMPORARY ISSUES • JIHAD • TERRORISM • EXTREMISM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.6: Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism, part of Muamalat (Social Relations) in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the effects of terrorism and extremism? 2. How can terrorism and extremism be curbed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify the rules of Jihad in Islam in groups and share in class,

2. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the correct interpretation of Jihad and make notes,

3. research online/available reference materials on the causes of terrorism and extremism and make notes,

4. research online/available reference materials on the effects of terrorism and present in class,

5. brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify the rules of Jihad in Islam in groups and share in class,
2. listen to a resource person giving a talk on the correct interpretation of Jihad and make notes,
3. research online/available reference materials on the causes of terrorism and extremism and make notes,
4. research online/available reference materials on the effects of terrorism and present in class,
5. brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Contemporary Issues • Jihad • Terrorism • Extremism together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: Global awareness skills are enhanced as learners research on the effects of terrorism and extremism.

• Communication and Collaboration: the skill of listening and speaking as learners brainstorm on the measures of

curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations.

• Critical thinking and Problem-solving: the skill of open-mindedness and creativity is enhanced as learners

brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class presentations.

Values:
• Peace is enhanced through discussion on the rules of Jihad in Islam in groups and sharing in class.

• Patriotism is enhanced as learners brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make

class presentations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Safety and Security education: as learners use digital devices to search for the effects and measures of curbing

terrorism and extremism.

• Peace education: as learners brainstorm on the measures of curbing terrorism and extremism and make class

presentations.

Link to other Subjects:

Social Studies as learners research on the effects of terrorism and extremism.
